scope: El Paso County - healthcare, mental health, school/childcare, employment, legal

records.name: Emergence Health Network 24/7 Crisis Hotline
records.organization: Emergence Health Network
records.description_en: A 24-hour phone line for anyone in a mental health or substance use crisis in El Paso. Staff can help right away and connect you to crisis services.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica abierta las 24 horas para cualquier persona en El Paso que esté pasando por una crisis de salud mental o de uso de sustancias. El personal le ayuda de inmediato y le conecta con servicios de crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in El Paso County having a mental health crisis, or worried about someone who is.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en el condado de El Paso que tenga una crisis de salud mental, o que esté preocupada por alguien que la tenga.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis hotline any time, day or night. You can also call, text, or chat 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora, de día o de noche. También puede llamar, mandar un mensaje de texto o chatear al 988.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.notes: Toll-free crisis line: 1-877-562-6467. The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline is also available 24/7. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.

records.name: Emergence Health Network Mental Health, Substance Use and IDD Services
records.organization: Emergence Health Network
records.description_en: El Paso's Local Mental Health Authority. It offers counseling, psychiatric care, substance use treatment, youth services, developmental disability services, and a primary care clinic.
records.description_es: Es la Autoridad Local de Salud Mental de El Paso. Ofrece consejería, atención psiquiátrica, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, servicios para jóvenes, servicios para discapacidades del desarrollo y una clínica de atención primaria.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children, teens, and adults in El Paso County who need mental health, addiction, or developmental disability services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños, adolescentes y adultos en el condado de El Paso que necesitan servicios de salud mental, adicciones o discapacidades del desarrollo.
records.how_to_apply: Call Centralized Scheduling to set up an appointment, or call Program Selection to learn which program fits you.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Programación Central (Centralized Scheduling) para hacer una cita, o llame a Selección de Programas (Program Selection) para saber qué programa es mejor para usted.
records.notes: Address is the administrative office (One San Jacinto Plaza). Program Selection: (915) 887-3410 or toll free (844) 600-3410. EHN also offers employment services and school-based mental health programs.

records.name: El Paso Child Guidance Center
records.organization: El Paso Child Guidance Center
records.description_en: Offers therapy, counseling, psychiatric evaluations, family counseling, and trauma-informed care for children, families, and adults.
records.description_es: Ofrece terapia, consejería, evaluaciones psiquiátricas, consejería familiar y atención que toma en cuenta el trauma, para niños, familias y adultos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People age 2 through adulthood with mental health challenges. Crime victims can get services at no cost.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas desde los 2 años hasta la edad adulta con problemas de salud mental. Las víctimas de un delito pueden recibir servicios sin costo.
records.how_to_apply: Call the center to ask for services. Spanish is spoken.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al centro para pedir servicios. Se habla español.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm
records.cost: Sliding scale based on income and family size; no one turned away for inability to pay
records.notes: Second location: 9001 Cashew Dr. Suite 300, El Paso, TX 79907 (East). Offers Parent Child Interaction Therapy (PCIT).

records.name: Aliviane Substance Use Treatment and Recovery Services
records.organization: Aliviane
records.description_en: Helps youth, adults, and families with drug and alcohol use through prevention, outpatient and residential treatment, opioid treatment, recovery support, and telehealth.
records.description_es: Ayuda a jóvenes, adultos y familias con el uso de drogas y alcohol. Ofrece prevención, tratamiento ambulatorio y residencial, tratamiento para opioides, apoyo en la recuperación y citas por video (telesalud).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Youth, adults, and families in the El Paso area dealing with alcohol or drug use.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes, adultos y familias del área de El Paso que tienen problemas con el alcohol o las drogas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number or the clinic that fits your need.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal o a la clínica que mejor le sirva.
records.notes: Residential: (915) 782-4014; Adult Outpatient: (915) 779-3764; Youth & Family Outpatient: (915) 782-4023; Opioid Treatment Clinic: (915) 779-4527.

records.name: Healthcare Options (Indigent Health Care) Program
records.organization: University Medical Center of El Paso
records.description_en: UMC's charity care program helps people with low income pay for hospital and medical care at UMC. Staff help you finish the application.
records.description_es: Es el programa de ayuda financiera (caridad) de UMC. Ayuda a personas de bajos ingresos a pagar la atención médica y del hospital en UMC. El personal le ayuda a completar la solicitud.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income El Paso residents. Eligibility is based on federal poverty guidelines and proof of residency.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de El Paso con bajos ingresos. Se decide según las guías federales de pobreza y el comprobante de que vive en el condado.
documents_needed: Proof of income (one): tax return, W-2, 2 recent paychecks, unemployment letter, employer letter, or bank statement
Two proofs of residency: mail, driver's license, school enrollment, property tax receipt, rent receipt, mortgage statement, or utility bill
Names of family members in your household
records.how_to_apply: Gather your documents and contact UMC's Healthcare Options office. Staff will help you apply and decide if you qualify.
records.how_to_apply_es: Reúna sus documentos y comuníquese con la oficina de Healthcare Options de UMC. El personal le ayudará a llenar la solicitud y verá si usted califica.
records.cost: Free or reduced cost if eligible
records.notes: Exact income percentage limit not stated on the page. Application forms available in English and Spanish. UMC main number: (915) 544-1200.

records.name: La Fe Central Clinic
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Primary care and adult dental care, plus prenatal care, lab, X-ray, pharmacy, eye care, diabetes education, and WIC on site.
records.description_es: Atención primaria y dental para adultos, además de cuidado prenatal, laboratorio, rayos X, farmacia, cuidado de los ojos, clases sobre diabetes y WIC en el mismo lugar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the community, including adults and pregnant women. Walk-ins welcome.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierta a la comunidad, incluidos adultos y mujeres embarazadas. Se atiende sin cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment, or walk in during clinic hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita, o vaya sin cita durante el horario de la clínica.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Pharmacy 8:30 a.m.-5:30 p.m.; Lab 6 a.m.-5:30 p.m.; WIC Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-6:30 p.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: La Fe is a community health center. Fees for uninsured patients were not listed on the clinic page; call to ask. Staff can help with Affordable Care Act marketplace sign-up.

records.name: La Fe San Elizario Clinic
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Family primary care and dental care, shots, well-child and well-woman exams, sports physicals, and diabetes education.
records.description_es: Atención primaria y dental para toda la familia, vacunas, chequeos para niños y mujeres, exámenes físicos para deportes y clases sobre diabetes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in the San Elizario area and El Paso County. Walk-ins welcome.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias del área de San Elizario y del condado de El Paso. Se atiende sin cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment, or walk in during clinic hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita, o vaya sin cita durante el horario de la clínica.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Pharmacy 9 a.m.-5 p.m.; Lab 7 a.m.-9:30 a.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: La Fe is a community health center. Fees for uninsured patients were not listed on the clinic page; call to ask. Staff can help with Affordable Care Act marketplace sign-up.

records.name: La Fe Westway Clinic
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Family primary care, dental care, shots, well-child and well-woman exams, pharmacy, and a community center with computer classes and tutoring.
records.description_es: Atención primaria y dental para toda la familia, vacunas, chequeos para niños y mujeres, farmacia y un centro comunitario con clases de computación y tutorías.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in the Canutillo/Westway area and El Paso County. Walk-ins welcome.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias del área de Canutillo/Westway y del condado de El Paso. Se atiende sin cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment, or walk in during clinic hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita, o vaya sin cita durante el horario de la clínica.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday-Friday 7 a.m.-5 p.m.; Pharmacy 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Lab 7 a.m.-9 a.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: La Fe is a community health center. Fees for uninsured patients were not listed on the clinic page; call to ask. Staff can help with Affordable Care Act marketplace sign-up.

records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Family primary care, shots, well-child and well-woman exams, sports physicals, lab, pharmacy, and a computer lab with free internet.
records.description_es: Atención primaria para toda la familia, vacunas, chequeos para niños y mujeres, exámenes físicos para deportes, laboratorio, farmacia y un salón de computadoras con internet gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in El Paso. Walk-ins welcome.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de El Paso. Se atiende sin cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment, or walk in during clinic hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita, o vaya sin cita durante el horario de la clínica.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Pharmacy 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Lab 7:30 a.m.-9 a.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: La Fe is a community health center. Fees for uninsured patients were not listed on the clinic page; call to ask. Staff can help with Affordable Care Act marketplace sign-up.

records.name: La Fe Yandell Adult Clinic
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Primary care for adults, with a focus on high blood pressure and diabetes. Has an in-house pharmacy for low-cost prescriptions.
records.description_es: Atención primaria para adultos, con enfoque en la presión alta y la diabetes. Tiene su propia farmacia con medicinas a bajo costo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults age 18 and older. Walk-ins welcome.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 18 años o más. Se atiende sin cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment, or walk in during clinic hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita, o vaya sin cita durante el horario de la clínica.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Pharmacy 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Lab 7:30 a.m.-10 a.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: La Fe is a community health center. Fees for uninsured patients were not listed on the clinic page; call to ask. Staff can help with Affordable Care Act marketplace sign-up.

records.name: La Fe Jose Roman MD Pediatric Clinic
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Children's clinic with well-child exams, sports physicals, shots, nutrition education, pharmacy, and WIC services.
records.description_es: Clínica para niños con chequeos de salud, exámenes físicos para deportes, vacunas, clases de nutrición, farmacia y servicios de WIC.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children from newborn to 17 years old.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde recién nacidos hasta los 17 años.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday-Friday 7 a.m.-6 p.m. (Wednesday 7:30 a.m.-5 p.m.); Pharmacy Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: La Fe is a community health center. Fees for uninsured patients were not listed on the clinic page; call to ask. Staff can help with Affordable Care Act marketplace sign-up.

records.name: La Fe Child & Adolescent Wellness Center
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Bilingual clinic for children and teens with shots, well-child exams, sports physicals, dental care, and eye and hearing screenings.
records.description_es: Clínica bilingüe para niños y adolescentes con vacunas, chequeos de salud, exámenes físicos para deportes, atención dental y revisiones de la vista y el oído.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children and teens. Walk-ins welcome.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños y adolescentes. Se atiende sin cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment, or walk in during clinic hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita, o vaya sin cita durante el horario de la clínica.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: La Fe is a community health center. Fees for uninsured patients were not listed on the clinic page; call to ask. Staff can help with Affordable Care Act marketplace sign-up.

records.name: La Fe Optometry Clinic
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: Eye exams, eyeglass prescriptions, and glaucoma screenings.
records.description_es: Exámenes de la vista, recetas para lentes y pruebas de glaucoma.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Registered La Fe patients age 6 and older. Most insurance accepted.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Pacientes registrados de La Fe de 6 años o más. Se aceptan la mayoría de los seguros.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Monday noon-5 p.m.; Tuesday 8 a.m.-12 p.m.; Thursday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Low cost; call to ask about fees for people without insurance
records.notes: Must be a registered La Fe patient. Contact lens prescriptions not available.

records.name: La Fe CARE Center (HIV care and free HIV testing)
records.organization: Centro de Salud Familiar La Fe
records.description_en: A one-stop clinic for people living with HIV, with medical care, pharmacy, counseling, support groups, and case management. Free HIV testing is open to everyone.
records.description_es: Una clínica con todo en un solo lugar para personas que viven con VIH: atención médica, farmacia, consejería, grupos de apoyo y manejo de casos. La prueba de VIH es gratis para todos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People living with HIV (proof of HIV status needed for most services). Free HIV testing for anyone.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven con VIH (para la mayoría de los servicios se necesita comprobante del diagnóstico). La prueba de VIH es gratis para cualquier persona.
documents_needed: Photo ID (state ID or driver's license)
Social Security card (if you have one)
Proof of HIV diagnosis (for most services)
records.how_to_apply: Call the CARE Center to make an appointment or ask about free testing.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al CARE Center para hacer una cita o preguntar por la prueba gratuita.
records.hours: Clinic: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m. (Tuesday until 8 p.m.; Saturday by appointment). Pharmacy: Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5:15 p.m.
records.cost: HIV testing free; call about other costs
records.notes: Runs a mobile HIV testing unit. Also offers PEP (post-exposure prophylaxis).

records.name: Project Vida Health Center
records.organization: Project Vida
records.description_en: A community health center with primary care, women's health, family planning, children's care, HIV/Hep C/PrEP care, behavioral health, and pharmacy. It also offers diabetes care and case management.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario con atención primaria, salud de la mujer, planificación familiar, atención para niños, cuidado de VIH/Hepatitis C/PrEP, salud mental y farmacia. También ofrece atención para la diabetes y manejo de casos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of El Paso County and nearby Hudspeth County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del condado de El Paso y del condado vecino de Hudspeth.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main office to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina principal para hacer una cita.
records.notes: Also offers early childhood, after-school, parenting education, and housing programs. Hours and sliding fee details not on website; call.

records.name: City of El Paso WIC Program
records.organization: City of El Paso Department of Public Health
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food benefits, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da beneficios para comprar comida saludable, consejos de nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding, or postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho o que acaban de dar a luz, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen con los límites de ingresos.
documents_needed: Proof of income or benefits programs
records.how_to_apply: Start online with the Texas WIC form or call 915-212-4942. Staff will call you to set up an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Empiece en línea con el formulario de WIC de Texas o llame al 915-212-4942. El personal le llamará para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (hours vary by location)
records.notes: Also reachable at (915) 212-0200. Location-specific hours are posted on the city WIC page. 24/7 Texas Lactation Support Hotline: 855-550-6667.

records.name: Rawlings Pediatric Dental Clinic
records.organization: City of El Paso Department of Public Health
records.description_en: Dental care for children and young adults, including cleanings, fluoride, sealants, fillings, root canals, and pulling teeth. Emergency visits available.
records.description_es: Atención dental para niños y jóvenes: limpiezas, fluoruro, selladores, rellenos (empastes), tratamientos de conducto y extracciones. También atiende emergencias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children from 6 months to their 21st birthday who live in El Paso County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde los 6 meses hasta antes de cumplir 21 años que viven en el condado de El Paso.
documents_needed: Three check stubs or an employer letter (for Title V or sliding fee)
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to make an appointment. Call the same number for emergencies.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para hacer una cita. Para emergencias, llame al mismo número.
records.hours: Tuesday-Friday, 7am to 6pm
records.cost: Accepts Medicaid, CHIP, private insurance; sliding fee based on family income; no one denied for inability to pay

records.name: City of El Paso Public Health Immunization Clinics
records.organization: City of El Paso Department of Public Health
records.description_en: Low-cost vaccines for uninsured children and adults at five city clinics. TB skin tests also offered.
records.description_es: Vacunas a bajo costo para niños y adultos en cinco clínicas de la ciudad. También hacen la prueba de tuberculosis (TB) en la piel.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children (0-18) and adults (19+) who are uninsured, underinsured, on Medicaid or CHIP, or American Indian/Alaska Native.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños (0 a 18 años) y adultos (19 años o más) sin seguro o con seguro que no cubre vacunas, con Medicaid o CHIP, o que son indígenas americanos o nativos de Alaska.
records.how_to_apply: Call to schedule a vaccine appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita para su vacuna.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 7:30 AM-4:00 PM (closed 12-1 PM)
records.cost: $10 administration fee per vaccine for uninsured; TB test $40. Eligible patients are not turned away for inability to pay the fee.
records.notes: Other clinics: Lower Valley 9341 Alameda Ave 79907; Henderson 721 S. Mesa St 79901; Northeast 9566 Railroad Dr 79924; Westside 7380 Remcon Circle 79912.

records.name: Free HIV, Syphilis and Hepatitis C Testing
records.organization: City of El Paso Department of Public Health
records.description_en: Free, private HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis C testing. Walk-ins welcome. Also helps with PrEP/PEP and getting into care.
records.description_es: Pruebas gratis y privadas de VIH, sífilis y hepatitis C. Puede ir sin cita. También ayudan con PrEP/PEP y a conectarse con atención médica.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone who wants to be tested.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que quiera hacerse la prueba.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during testing hours; no appointment needed.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya durante el horario de pruebas; no necesita cita.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM-11:30 AM and 1:00 PM-4:30 PM; every 3rd Wednesday 5:00 PM-8:00 PM
records.notes: Sexual Health (STD) Clinic: 4240 Alameda Ave, 79905, (915) 212-6591, Mon-Thu 8 AM-6 PM, Fri 8 AM-12 PM. Also offers HOPWA housing help for people with HIV.

records.name: TB Control Clinic
records.organization: City of El Paso Department of Public Health
records.description_en: Tuberculosis testing, treatment, and case management for El Paso County.
records.description_es: Pruebas, tratamiento y seguimiento de casos de tuberculosis (TB) para el condado de El Paso.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in El Paso County who need TB services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en el condado de El Paso que necesitan servicios de tuberculosis.
documents_needed: Medicaid or Medicare card if you have one
records.how_to_apply: Walk in or call the clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya sin cita o llame a la clínica.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday, 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (closed 12:00-1:00 p.m.)

records.name: 2-1-1 Call Center (El Paso)
records.organization: City of El Paso Department of Public Health
records.description_en: A free phone line that connects you to local help for child care, medical care, counseling, housing, food, and elder care.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica gratis que le conecta con ayuda local para cuidado de niños, atención médica, consejería, vivienda, comida y cuidado de personas mayores.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone looking for community services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que busque servicios en la comunidad.
records.how_to_apply: Dial 2-1-1 any time.
records.how_to_apply_es: Marque 2-1-1 a cualquier hora.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.notes: Also reachable at (915) 212-0200. Toll-free: 1 (877) 541-7905; alternate (915) 212-6631; out of state 1 (800) 644-1917. 211 cannot give money directly or handle emergencies (call 911).

records.name: CareForce Child Care Scholarships
records.organization: Workforce Solutions Borderplex
records.description_en: Helps working families and parents in school or training pay for child care. It can also pay eligible relatives who care for children.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias que trabajan y a padres que estudian o se capacitan a pagar el cuidado de sus hijos. También puede pagarle a familiares que cuidan a los niños, si califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families earning at or below 85% of state median income, where parents work, go to school, or train at least 25 hours a week.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias que ganan el 85% o menos del ingreso medio del estado, donde los padres trabajan, estudian o se capacitan al menos 25 horas por semana.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Brewster, Culberson, El Paso, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, or Presidio County resident

documents_needed: Proof of income / wage verification form
School enrollment verification (if in school or training)
records.how_to_apply: Create an account and pre-screen at childcare.twc.texas.gov. You will get an email when the full application opens; then send your documents.
records.how_to_apply_es: Cree una cuenta y llene el formulario de preselección en childcare.twc.texas.gov. Recibirá un correo cuando se abra la solicitud completa; entonces envíe sus documentos.
records.cost: Free or reduced cost (parent share may apply)
records.notes: Waitlist may be 6-12 months or longer. Maximum monthly gross income: family of 2 $5,216; 3 $6,443; 4 $7,670; 5 $8,897. Watch for email from no-reply@childcare.texas.gov.

records.name: ESC Region 19 Head Start and Early Head Start
records.organization: Education Service Center Region 19
records.description_en: Free early learning for young children with health, nutrition, family, and special needs services at about 32 centers.
records.description_es: Educación temprana gratis para niños pequeños, con servicios de salud, nutrición, apoyo a la familia y necesidades especiales, en unos 32 centros.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children birth to age 5 in El Paso and Hudspeth counties whose families meet federal poverty guidelines. Children in foster care, experiencing homelessness, or in families getting TANF or SSI qualify regardless of income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde el nacimiento hasta los 5 años en los condados de El Paso y Hudspeth cuyas familias cumplen las guías federales de pobreza. Los niños en cuidado temporal (foster care), sin hogar, o de familias que reciben TANF o SSI califican sin importar sus ingresos.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: El Paso or Hudspeth County resident

documents_needed: Proof of child's age (such as a birth certificate)
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online pre-application or contact a Family Service Worker at any Head Start center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la presolicitud en línea o hable con un Trabajador de Servicios a la Familia en cualquier centro de Head Start.
records.notes: Pre-application does not guarantee enrollment; centers keep waiting lists. Center list: https://www.esc19hs.net/head_start___early_head_start_centers

records.name: YWCA El Paso Child Care and Tuition Assistance
records.organization: YWCA El Paso
records.description_en: Offers child care, after-school programs, and camps with tuition assistance, plus adult education and literacy classes.
records.description_es: Ofrece cuidado de niños, programas después de la escuela y campamentos con ayuda para pagar la colegiatura, además de clases de educación y alfabetización para adultos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in El Paso. Call to ask about scholarship rules.

records.name: NextForce Youth Program
records.organization: Workforce Solutions Borderplex
records.description_en: Free career counseling, workshops, tutoring, work experience, job training, and help with school costs, transportation, and child care for teens and young adults.

records.eligibility_summary_en: Young people ages 14 to 24 who live in El Paso, Brewster, Culberson, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, or Presidio County and are allowed to work in the U.S.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes de 14 a 24 años que viven en los condados de El Paso, Brewster, Culberson, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis o Presidio y que tienen permiso para trabajar en EE. UU.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Brewster, Culberson, El Paso, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, or Presidio County resident

records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online qualification form on the NextForce page, or call or email NextForce.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario de requisitos en línea en la página de NextForce, o llame o escriba un correo a NextForce.
records.notes: Email: nextforce@borderplexjobs.com. Must be a U.S. citizen or authorized to work; men 18+ must be registered with Selective Service.

records.name: Project ARRIBA Workforce Training
records.organization: Project ARRIBA
records.description_en: Helps people train for good jobs, like nursing and other healthcare careers, with support to finish school and get hired.
records.description_es: Ayuda a las personas a prepararse para buenos trabajos, como enfermería y otras carreras de salud, con apoyo para terminar sus estudios y conseguir empleo.

records.notes: Specific eligibility and income rules not stated on the website.

records.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid - El Paso Office
records.organization: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for people with low income, such as housing and tenant problems, family law, and public benefits.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis en casos civiles para personas de bajos ingresos, como problemas de vivienda y de inquilinos, derecho familiar y beneficios públicos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income people in TRLA's service area, including El Paso County. Call to see if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de bajos ingresos en el área que atiende TRLA, incluido el condado de El Paso. Llame para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-5 p.m. Central Time. For family law, call on Tuesdays and Thursdays only.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión de lunes a viernes de 9 a.m. a 5 p.m. hora del Centro (8 a.m. a 4 p.m. hora de El Paso). Para casos de familia, llame solo los martes y jueves.
records.hours: Intake: Monday-Friday 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Central Time
records.notes: Toll-free intake: (833) 329-8752. El Paso is on Mountain Time, so intake hours are 8 a.m.-4 p.m. local time. The El Paso office has no separate listed phone; use the intake line. Income limits not stated on page.
